newsitem.title: USA: Century Telephone wins 12 PCS licenses.
newsitem.headline: Century Telephone wins 12 PCS licenses.

text.p: Century Telephone Enterprises Inc said on Tuesday it was awarded 12 Personal Communication Service, or PCS, licenses in the Federal Communications Commission's D and E block auctions.
Century's licenses include 10-MHz of spectrum and cover markets with a population of about four million people. They cover 11 Basic Trading Areas in Michigan and one in Vicksburg, Miss.

"This additional wireless spectrum complements our existing service clusters and will allow us to competitively attract new customers as well as offer value-added services to our existing customers," said Glen Post III, Century's president and chief executive.
Century said its total investment for this spectrum is about $4.6 million. Construction of networks in these areas is expected to begin during 1997.
